items.placementTarget: Rulebook page 15, slot U (GAME END, under the loss bullets)
items.text: • If you are unable to place a Hollow Men figure on the board when needed.

rules: The sticker is only this bullet. It does not itself say that the game ends.
It is placed in the list of ways the game ends in a loss, after the incident-track loss and the failure to draw 2 player cards.
The trigger is being unable to place a Hollow Men figure when the rules require one.
mechanics.effect: Adds running out of Hollow Men figures as a loss condition.

summary: Extra game-end bullet, placed on the loss list: being unable to place a Hollow Men figure when one is required.
